x: Welcome to Neil Webster and Ben Brown who clearly showed talent that will make next season exciting. Also a special mention to Ben Cooper who, as our youngest runner (8), closed the team at the Ranelagh Open to secure his first ever Team Medal and with three more years as a Mini-Colt certainly not the last.

Throughout the season there was some outstanding individual performances from Ed Bojtler, Baber Khan, Alexander Stevens, Dan Winson and Neil Webster and not least, Steven Fox, one of the boys who steadily moved through the field.
